entities.summary: Eduard Nikolayevich Schensnovich (Shchensnovich) (Russian: Эдуа́рд Никола́евич Щенсно́вич, romanized: Eduárd Nikoláevič Ščensnóvič; Polish: Edward Nikołajewicz Szczęsnowicz; January 6, 1852 – January 3, 1911) was an admiral in the Imperial Russian Navy.
